description: This Java class defines an exception used within the OpenMRS framework to signal that user input is required for some database update process. It contains an enum for data types, a map to hold prompts and their required data types, and constructors/methods to access this required input information.

classes.name: InputRequiredException
classes.description: Exception used to indicate that user input is required for a database update, holding prompts and data types for expected inputs.

methods.name: InputRequiredException
methods.description: Constructor accepting a map of required input prompts and their data types.

methods.name: getRequiredInput
methods.description: Returns the map of prompts and their expected data types.

inner_enums.name: DATATYPE
inner_enums.description: Enumeration of data types for user input: STRING, INTEGER, DOUBLE, DATE.
